eyebrow: Two ways to process new data
code:
# FULL reprocessing: read the entire bronze table every run.
#   Simple, always correct -- wasteful at scale.
#
# INCREMENTAL: read only what's actually new since last time.
#   Faster, cheaper -- requires knowing what "new" means.
caption: The real tradeoff every real pipeline eventually has to make.
